justification: Dev-tooling guardrails (a PreToolUse prior-art injector + a pre-push jscpd duplication ratchet). No product/runtime code, no DB, no user-facing output — but it gates the developer workflow (can block Write/push), so it is reviewed at standard tier for fail-safety.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data. Reads the PreToolUse hook stdin JSON (tool_name, tool_input.file_path, tool_input.content) and the git working tree via `git grep`.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Could over-block (false positive) and stall legitimate work, or under-block (miss a real duplicate). Mitigated: blocks only NEW files in watched code dirs with a STRONG overlap signal, has an explicit ack escape hatch, and FAILS OPEN on any internal error so a hook bug never halts edits.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New PreToolUse(Write) hook registered alongside the existing pre-edit-guard; new pre-push step #6 added after the mutmut block. Reuses the existing hook conventions (Python script, stdin JSON, exit 2 = block). jscpd runs via npx (no node_modules coupling).

functions.name: tokens
functions.input: a single identifier, filename, or path-segment string to be tokenised
functions.output: set of lowercased concern tokens (len>=4, stopwords dropped, camelCase split)
functions.if_none: empty/blank string -> empty set -> the hook exits 0 (allow), never blocks on no signal

values: N/A - no regulatory or business values. Constants are the jscpd threshold (8%, baseline 6.77%) and the stopword/watched-dir lists; all dev-tooling tunables.
queries: N/A - no database queries. The only external call is `git grep` (read-only) over tracked/untracked code files, with a 12s timeout and fail-open on error.

break_it.scenario: A new file is created whose concern genuinely duplicates existing code (e.g. services/planning_eligibility.py vs the frontend eligibility engine)
break_it.what_happens: Without the guard the model silently builds a parallel implementation (the exact failure this session)
break_it.repro: echo '{"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"services/planning_eligibility.py","content":"def evaluate_eligibility(z): return True"}}' | python .claude/hooks/prior-art-guard.py ; echo exit=$?  (expect 2)
break_it.how: git grep finds strong path/token overlap -> exit 2 with the candidate files listed; verified it blocks and surfaces nsw-planning-portal.ts / assess-eligibility.ts

break_it.scenario: A genuinely-new file is legitimately needed, or the model has reviewed the candidates and is extending none
break_it.what_happens: A hard block would deadlock (re-issuing the same Write re-blocks)
break_it.repro: pipe the same Write JSON but with content containing a line 'prior-art-checked: backend SoT' into the hook; echo exit=$?  (expect 0)
break_it.how: escape hatch: a `prior-art-checked:` line in the content allows the write through (forced, auditable acknowledgment); verified exit 0 with the ack line

break_it.scenario: The hook errors internally (git missing, bad input, timeout) or a non-code/test/overwrite file is written
break_it.what_happens: A fail-closed guard would block all edits on its own bug (the node_modules/pre-impl class of outage)
break_it.repro: pipe a Write JSON for file_path tests/test_x.py (or any non-watched path, or malformed JSON) into the hook; echo exit=$?  (expect 0)
break_it.how: every error path and non-watched/overwrite/test path calls sys.exit(0) (fail-open); verified novel + test files and overwrites pass

break_it.scenario: jscpd cannot run in pre-push (no network/npx cache), or the push touches no source code
break_it.what_happens: A naive gate would block the push on tooling failure or waste ~40s on docs-only pushes
break_it.repro: push a branch that changes only docs/config and confirm step [6] prints 'No source code changed — skipping duplication ratchet' and does not block
break_it.how: the ratchet skips when no source code changed, and only blocks on the explicit 'too many duplicates' threshold message; any other non-zero jscpd exit warns and continues

post_merge.manual_verify: After merge, the prior-art guard runs on every new code-file Write (block + ack hatch); the jscpd ratchet runs on pushes that change source. Tighten the 8% threshold in .jscpd.json downward as the eligibility consolidation removes existing duplication.
